lines.name: Big Twist® Winter Bulky Stripes Yarn
lines.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle. Non-chlorine bleach only. Dry flat. Do not iron.
lines.description:
Big Twist Winter Bulky is a festive, striped skein perfect for when your handmade creations call for a bit of holiday cheer. This premium acrylic yarn will work well for making cozy Christmas throw blankets, warm hats and scarves for snowy days, huggable stuffed animals to place under the tree and more! With a variety of color mixes to select from, this yarn is an excellent choice for most any project that inspires you!


We understand the importance of dye lots and will try to match dye lots for your order, however, we cannot guarantee all skeins will be the same dye lot.


Weight: Bulky (5)


Contents: 100% premium acrylic

Skein Weight: 7 oz. / 200 g

Yardage: 131.2 yd. / 120 m


Knitting Gauge:

10 sts - 15 rows = 4" (10 cm)

Crochet Gauge:

8 sc - 5 rows = 4" (10 cm)


Suggested Knitting Needle:

9 to 10 mm, US - 13 to 15

Suggested Crochet Hook:

8 mm, US - L/11

lines.name: Caron® Birthday Cupcakes™ Yarn
lines.care: Machine wash (not exceeding 104°F/40°C), delicate setting. Do not bleach. Tumble dry, low heat, delicate setting. Do not iron or press. Do not dry clean.
lines.description:
Caron Birthday Cupcakes are a super-sweet mini version of Caron Cakes, including a faux fur pom pom on top! One cupcake makes a colorful hat, and accessorizing is easy with the matching pom pom. This 100% acrylic yarn is easy care and easy to love.


We understand the importance of dye lots and will try to match dye lots for your order, however, we cannot guarantee all skeins will be the same dye lot.


Weight: Bulky (5)


Contents: 100% acrylic yarn with 50% polyester, 50% olefin pom pom

Skein Weight: 3.5 oz. / 100 g

Yardage: 138 yd. / 126 m


Knitting Gauge:

13 sts - 18 rows = 4" (10 cm)

Crochet Gauge:

9 sc - 10 rows = 4" (10 cm)


Suggested Knitting Needle:

6.5 mm, US - 10.5

Suggested Crochet Hook:

6.5 mm, US - K/10.5

lines.name: Caron® Slice of Anniversary Cakes™ Yarn
lines.care: Machine wash (not exceeding 104°F/40°C) on permanent press setting. Do not bleach. Tumble dry, low heat, delicate setting. Do not iron or press. Do not dry clean.
lines.description:
Love Caron Anniversary Cakes but want something a little more snackable? Meet Caron Slice of Anniversary Cakes—the smaller spin on the fan-favorite classic. With the same soft, squishy feel and vibrant colorways, this 250g cake is perfect for bite-sized projects, bold accents and mix-and-match color play. Whether you're whipping up a chunky hat, layering stripes into a larger make, or just testing a new palette, Slice of Anniversary Cakes gives you the magic of the original—smaller size, same bold energy. It's the perfect slice of crafting fun.


We understand the importance of dye lots and will try to match dye lots for your order, however, we cannot guarantee all skeins will be the same dye lot.

8 mm, US - 11

8 mm, US - L/11

lines.name: Grande Ombre™ Yarn by Loops & Threads®
lines.description:
Grande Ombre from Loops and Threads is a plush super bulky yarn perfect for creating cuddly knit and crochet crafts and accessories with a pretty ombre effect. This super soft chenille yarn is available in a range of fun colors that gradually shift from bold, rich tones to softer hues as you work through the skein. It's great for stitching up eye-catching sweaters, cozy scarves, blankets you'll want to curl up in and so much more!


We recommend pulling the yarn from the outside of the skein, as pulling from the center of the skein may cause shedding.


We understand the importance of dye lots and will try to match dye lots for your order, however, we cannot guarantee all skeins will be the same dye lot.

lines.name: Bernat® Fluffee™ Yarn
lines.description:
The Bernat® Fluffee yarn has a cloud-like weightlessness that works up with ease and has a comforting fluffy texture. The polyester blend, made primarily of polyester fibers, is complemented by nylon fibers that help prevent shedding. You can use this bold and rich colored yarn in home décor and apparel projects like making throw pillow covers, scarves, sweaters or a snuggly blanket.
